shared_elements: figures shown in profile or near-profile
justification: Both show low-relief human figures accompanied by animals, and both organise the figures along a horizontal band, but that is a very generic correspondence. A shows a crowded, dynamic scene of figures with raised arms grappling around a quadruped in high, rounded modelling, whereas B shows orderly processional files of evenly spaced, upright standing figures leading animals, separated by ornamental borders and stylised trees — different compositional logic, posture conventions and relief handling.
